title: Counting Minutes Delivered at a Non-Covered Insured Plan of Care Visit
content:
On the Insured Plan of Care, the minutes delivered at a non-covered visit are counted from the appointment record of the Appointment Series the plan of care funds:

- **In-clinic visit, patient late within the grace period, in a series that sees a late arrival for the remaining slot time:** the slot length less the minutes late. The patient counts as late within the grace period when the minutes late recorded on the attended appointment are more than zero and no more than the series' grace period for late arrival.
- **Telehealth treatment visit:** the timed units billed for the visit times the minutes in one timed unit, which is **15 minutes**.
- **Any other visit:** the full slot length.

The Appointment Series record supplies the slot length, the grace period for late arrival and whether a late arrival is seen only for the remaining slot time; the attended-appointment entry for the visit's date supplies the minutes late.

## Input, judgement and output (hypothetical series with 45-minute slots and a 10-minute grace period)

| Visit | Minutes late recorded | Series sees a late arrival for the remaining slot time | Minutes delivered |
|---|---|---|---|
| In-clinic | 8 | Yes | 37 (45 less 8) |
| In-clinic | 10 | Yes | 35 — exactly at the grace period, still within it |
| In-clinic | 11 | Yes | 45 — beyond the grace period, so the full slot length |
| In-clinic | 8 | No | 45 — the series does not shorten late visits |
| In-clinic | 0 | Yes | 45 — not late |
| Telehealth treatment, 2 timed units billed | — | — | 30 (2 times 15) |
| Telehealth treatment, 3 timed units billed | — | — | 45 (3 times 15) |
